lines.3: A clear voice tickles my eardrums.
lines.4: 「If you refuse to wake up, I'll have to use force.」
lines.8: Otome's foot is resting on my knee.
lines.9: Actually, she's steadily putting her weight into it and stomping down.
lines.10: 「If you don't wake up, I'll demonstrate a technique I've been wanting to test in live combat. Right here.」
lines.13: 「W-wait, I'm up! In fact, I was already awake!」
lines.14: I can't have her busting out some insane finishing move first thing in the morning.
lines.16: 「I'll be in the living room. If you go back to sleep, I truly won't hold back next time.」
lines.18: Well, I might as well head to the washroom and splash some water on my face.
lines.21: Otome was watching TV in the living room.
lines.22: Looks like a period drama had just started.
lines.23: 「That's a tune that straightens you right up. Nothing beats listening to it before school.」
lines.25: 「Now, I'm leaving early for my disciplinary committee duties. Breakfast is right there.」
lines.29: 「Also, your uniform is hanging there. I believe I laid out everything you'll need, but make sure you check it yourself.」
lines.31: 「I checked as well, but before you leave, always make sure the gas valve is shut, the lights are off, and the doors are locked.」
lines.33: 「Then I'll be off. If you're late, I won't go easy on you.」
lines.35: Even after second term started, Otome was still doing morning gate duty as disciplinary committee chair. Hard at work from the crack of dawn--you have to admire her.
lines.36: That said, I've got a morning job of my own.
